description: A PostHog feature flag: a key that SDKs evaluate to roll features out to a percentage of users, to specific users or groups, or to serve multivariate variants and payloads.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

ProjectId.description: ID of the PostHog project the feature flag belongs to.

Key.description: Feature flag key that SDKs evaluate, e.g. new-checkout. Must be unique within the project.

Name.description: Description of the feature flag (PostHog stores it in the `name` field for backwards compatibility).

Filters.description: Targeting configuration as a JSON object (use Fn::ToJsonString): `groups` (release condition groups with `properties`, `rollout_percentage` and optional `variant`), `multivariate` (`variants` with `key` and `rollout_percentage`), `payloads` (payload values keyed by variant key, or `true` for boolean flags), `aggregation_group_type_index` and `early_exit`. Leave unset for a flag with no release conditions.

Active.description: Whether the feature flag is enabled. Defaults to true.

Archived.description: Whether the flag is archived. Archived flags are hidden from the flag list by default and must be disabled (Active: false).

Tags.description: Organizational tags for the feature flag.

EvaluationContexts.description: Evaluation contexts that control where the flag evaluates at runtime. PostHog does not return this field, so it is write-only.

IsRemoteConfiguration.description: Whether this flag is a remote configuration flag that delivers a payload rather than gating a feature.

EnsureExperienceContinuity.description: Whether to persist a user's flag value across the anonymous-to-identified transition. Incompatible with device_id bucketing.

EvaluationRuntime.description: Where the flag is allowed to evaluate: `server` (server-side SDKs only), `client` (client-side SDKs only) or `all` (both, the default).

BucketingIdentifier.description: Identifier used to bucket users into rollout percentages and variants: `distinct_id` (the default) or `device_id`. `device_id` is incompatible with EnsureExperienceContinuity.

UpdatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last update.
